document: lifted by lift.mjs from website/product.json and website/data/status.json
note: Node path of the lifted document -> CSS selector of the element it stands for on the built page. Stage 0 checks that every selector matches exactly one element before a campaign starts.
unmapped: the second line of the title is emphasised (<em>); a page title is one plain string
the kicker's dot, the feature numbers, the status glyphs and the status bar are decoration with no node
links outside the landing (navbar, footer) are not lifted; both stages count them as fixed routes
colour, type scale and spacing: the terminal renderer draws no tokens, so density and heading scale are axes of the browser stage only
